title: Average true range
description: The typical size of a one-minute bar, counting any gap from the previous close. A plain measure of how far the price usually travels in a minute.

atr.label: Bar range
atr.description: The average high-to-low range of recent one-minute bars, in dollars. Bigger means each minute carries the price further.

atr_bps.label: Bar range
atr_bps.description: The same average range as a share of price, in basis points. Easier to compare across price levels.
